questions.question: On this day in 475, which youth was installed on the imperial throne by his father Orestes as the final Western Roman Emperor?
questions.explanation: On 31 October 475, Romulus Augustulus assumed the Western Roman throne, serving as the empire's last Western ruler before his deposition the next year.
questions.context:
On this day in 475: Romulus Augustulus took the throne as the last emperor of the Western Roman Empire.
Romulus Augustulus (Western Roman emperor from 475 to 476): Romulus Augustus, nicknamed Augustulus, was Roman emperor of the West from 31 October 475 until 4 September 476. Romulus was placed on the imperial throne while still a minor by his father Orestes, the magister militum, for whom he served as little more than a figurehead.

questions.question: Who composed the songs, book and lyrics for the stage musical on which the 1975 film The Rocky Horror Picture Show is based?
questions.explanation: Richard O'Brien wrote the music, book and lyrics for the original stage musical, co-wrote the screenplay, and played Riff Raff in the film adaptation.
questions.context:
The Rocky Horror Picture Show (1975 musical comedy horror film by Jim Sharman): The Rocky Horror Picture Show is a 1975 musical comedy horror film produced by Lou Adler and Michael White, directed by Jim Sharman, and distributed by 20th Century Fox. The film is based on the 1973 musical stage production The Rocky Horror Show, with music, book and lyrics by Richard O'Brien.
The screenplay was written by Sharman and O'Brien, with O'Brien also playing the supporting role Riff Raff.

questions.question: With which musical girl group did Leigh-Anne Pinnock win the eighth series of The X Factor?
questions.explanation: Leigh-Anne Pinnock rose to fame as a member of Little Mix, which formed and triumphed on The X Factor before scoring numerous number-one hits.
questions.context: Leigh-Anne Pinnock (English singer (born 1991)): Leigh-Anne Pinnock is an English singer and actress. She rose to prominence as a member of the girl group Little Mix, which was formed on and won the eighth series of The X Factor. As part of the group, she won three Brit Awards and achieved 19 top-ten singles and five number-one entries on the UK Singles Chart before the group went on hiatus in 2022.

questions.question: Which reality dating competition has been hosted by British broadcaster Maya Jama since 2023?
questions.explanation: Maya Jama took over presenting duties on Love Island in 2023, having previously presented programmes like Glow Up.
questions.context: Maya Jama (British television and radio presenter (born 1994)): Maya Indea Jama is a British broadcaster and media personality. She began her career as a presenter for MTV, 4Music and BBC Radio 1. She has presented television shows, including The Circle (2017), Glow Up: Britain's Next Make-Up Star (2021–2022), and Love Island (2023–present). Since 2025, Jama has appeared as a panellist on the ITV musical competition The Masked Singer. In 2026, she was a contestant on the second series of the BBC reality show The Celebrity Traitors.

questions.question: Which of these stand-up comedy specials was performed by comedian James Acaster?
questions.explanation: James Acaster is well known for his celebrated comedy shows, including the stand-up special Cold Lasagne Hate Myself 1999.
questions.context: James Acaster (English comedian (born 1985)): James William Acaster is an English comedian, presenter, podcaster, actor and musician. As well as the stand-up specials Repertoire and Cold Lasagne Hate Myself 1999, he is known for co-hosting the food podcast Off Menu and the panel show Hypothetical. Acaster makes use of fictional characters within his stand-up comedy, which is characterised by frequent callback jokes, offbeat observational comedy and overarching stories.
